$comment: opencode runtime settings for Alan. Merge the `agent` block into your opencode.json; the prompt is portable/opencode/agents/alan.md and opencode reads it from .opencode/agents/alan.md.
$permissionComment: Alan commits, pushes and opens pull requests, so bash is allowed. He must never merge — that is stated in the prompt and enforced by his forge credential, not here. opencode's permission model is coarse (allow/ask/deny per tool class) and cannot express 'git push yes, merge no'; scope the token instead.
